response.overview: After an unexpected breakup, the BOY’s world is drained of color. His life fades to gray as he sees flashes of the future he pictured: marriage, fatherhood. At the end of a long and lonesome period of confusion, sadness, and an inability to grapple with his new reality, a simple interaction at his usual coffee shop just might bring all of the color back into his world.
response.title: Beyond The Past
